name: Ria
message: 「Ta-da~! Special Valentine's chocolate made by yours truly, Ria-senpai~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Or so you thought--it's actually choco monaka!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry... Whenever I make something, it always ends up turning into traditional Japanese sweets...」

name: Ria
message: 「But I guarantee it tastes great! After all, I made su~re to taste-test it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... I'm a glutton? N-No I'm not!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph! If you're gonna say mean things like that, then I'm not giving it to you after all~. Humph!」
